name: Accessibility Compliance
description: Comprehensive accessibility audit and fixes: ARIA labels, keyboard navigation, screen reader support, color contrast verification, focus management, and semantic HTML improvements across all pages
acceptanceCriteria: All interactive elements (buttons, links, form inputs) reachable via keyboard Tab navigation
Focus indicators visible and styled consistently with wedding palette
ARIA labels on landmark sections (hero, story chapters, RSVP form, venue map)
Skip-to-content link available for keyboard users
Color contrast ratios meet WCAG 2.1 AA (4.5:1 for normal text, 3:1 for large text)
Screen reader announces page structure correctly (headings, regions, lists)
Map iframe has accessible title and fallback content
Guest personalization announced correctly by screen readers
pnpm lint, pnpm typecheck, pnpm build pass
notes: Wedding guests will include elderly users and users with disabilities. Accessibility is not optional for a real product. Current reduced-motion support exists but broader a11y has not been audited. Focus on practical improvements, not theoretical perfection.
